The Cost of Patience

By Sam Ortiz · Feb 2, 2026

When the first shipment arrived, nobody cheered, but several people stayed late to unpack it. Marta kept a ledger of every tide, a habit inherited from a grandfather she never met. By midweek the numbers no longer matched the stories the fishermen told at the dock.

When the first shipment arrived, nobody cheered, but several people stayed late to unpack it. Critics called the plan sentimental; the accountants called it the cheapest option on the table. The report concluded that patience, not funding, had been the scarce resource all along.
